short_summary: South Africa joins six other nations in the international race to host the 2036 Summer Olympic Games.

sources.name: BBC Sport
sources.title: South Africa hope to host first African Olympics

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.title: South Africa in running to stage Africa’s first Olympics as 2036 race hots up

paragraphs: The International Olympic Committee has confirmed that seven countries are currently in continuous dialogue to host the 2036 Summer Olympic Games. Among them, South Africa is hoping to make history by bringing the multi-sport event to the African continent for the very first time. According to proposals, the South African bid would be distributed across three major urban centers: Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, the latter of which was previously set to host the 2022 Commonwealth Games before withdrawing in 2017.

Alongside South Africa, nations such as Hungary, India, Qatar, Turkey, Germany, and the Republic of Korea are participating in discussions with the governing body. Bidders faced an October 31 deadline to formalize their expressions of interest before delivering virtual presentations to the future host commission in November. Following this initial stage, the International Olympic Committee will conduct comprehensive feasibility assessments by March 2027, after which national Olympic committees will enter strategic dialogue. The selection process will conclude with a vote in the summer of 2029, following a targeted dialogue opening in December 2028.

Observers note that Qatar currently stands as the frontrunner in the competitive race, partly due to the perceived strength of the bid and the fact that Asia has not hosted a Games since Tokyo 2020. However, a tournament hosted in Doha would likely require rescheduling away from the traditional July and August window due to extreme heat. Meanwhile, India's bid centers on the city of Ahmedabad, which will welcome the 2030 Commonwealth Games and has bid for the 2038 Asian Games, featuring the massive Narendra Modi stadium. Yet, analysts report that governance issues, a lack of bid detail, and the country's dismal performance at the Paris Games have slowed its momentum. Hungary's well-regarded proposal features Budapest alongside neighboring Austrian capital Vienna and Slovakian capital Bratislava, though questions linger regarding governmental support compared to the era of Viktor Orban. Budapest previously staged the World Aquatics Championships in 2022 and World Athletics Championships in 2023.

Other contenders include Turkey, which nominated Istanbul. Istanbul previously bid unsuccessfully for the 2000, 2008, and 2020 Games and is set to host the 2027 European Games. Germany and South Korea are also exploring bids, with Munich bidding again for 2036 after previously hosting in 1972, while Berlin hosted in 1936. South Korea's bid involves Seoul, which hosted in 1988, alongside the province of North Jeolla. Most other participating nations are presently viewed by observers as placeholders laying groundwork for future editions, with the UK government discussing potential bids for the 2040s. Meanwhile, upcoming editions are already assigned, with Los Angeles preparing for 2028 and Brisbane set to host in 2032, marking Australia's return as host after 32 years.

facts.fact: South Africa is among seven countries expressing interest in hosting the 2036 Summer Olympics, hoping to become the first African host.
The other countries interested in the 2036 Games are Hungary, India, Qatar, Turkey, Germany, and South Korea.
Interested parties have a deadline of October 31 for submissions of stated interest and will give virtual presentations in November.
Qatar is widely regarded as the frontrunner in the bidding process, though a Doha Olympics might require a shift from the traditional July-August slot due to extreme heat.
South Africa's proposal involves spreading events across three cities: Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban.
India's bid centers on Ahmedabad, though it faces challenges following past management issues and a poor performance in Paris.
Hungary's bid involves Budapest alongside Vienna and Bratislava, though questions remain regarding political backing.
The International Olympic Committee will carry out feasibility assessments by March 2027, with a final vote scheduled for the summer of 2029.
The 2028 Olympic Games will take place in Los Angeles, and Brisbane will host the 2032 Games.
